notes: Curated eval for the craft-pass output contract. Routing prompts stay on practitioner language; output checks require the skill's leading test, not a section list.

should_trigger.prompt: Please build a structured objection handling library from qualified objection evidence, with response patterns, proof, and escalation rules.
Please create or improve reusable objection handling by segment, stage, persona, or competitor context.
I have rough notes. Please turn them into a usable objection library and label anything that still needs confirmation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Please analyze a defined set of sales calls or notes and produce an evidence-backed objection brief by segment, persona, or stage.
Please review one sales call and turn recording, transcript, or notes evidence into clear coaching priorities and next-practice actions.
Please build and refine value propositions and messaging frameworks for revenue teams.

output_structure_checks.name: objection-library-builder-core-output
output_structure_checks.description: Play cards diagnose before they answer, preserve source wording, and include escalation plus proof approval state.

output_structure_checks.name: objection-library-builder-decision-discipline
output_structure_checks.description: Makes the requested decision or next action explicit while separating verified evidence, provisional assumptions, conflicts, and decision-critical unknowns.
